req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 400 error when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body. This ensures data integrity by preventing updates to the wrong player record. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior when IDs match, a negative test for mismatched IDs, and a boundary test to check behavior with edge-case values.

tests.name: test_put_player_id_match
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with matching squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    '/players/squadnumber/1',
    json={
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "middleName": "",
        "lastName": "Banerjee",
        "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Manchester City",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_player_id_mismatch
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with a different squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    '/players/squadnumber/1',
    json={
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "middleName": "",
        "lastName": "Banerjee",
        "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 2,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Manchester City",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
)
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_put_player_boundary_case
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with maximum length strings for names.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    '/players/squadnumber/1',
    json={
        "firstName": "X" * 50,
        "middleName": "X" * 50,
        "lastName": "X" * 50,
        "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Manchester City",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
)
assert response.status_code == 204
